name: Ben-Abinadab
title: Solomon's Overseer of the Region of Dor
summary: Ben-Abinadab was one of Solomon's twelve officers who supplied provisions for the king's household. He was in charge of the region of Dor and was married to Taphath, Solomon's daughter.

keyEvents.title: Officer under Solomon
keyEvents.description: Ben-Abinadab was the officer over all the land of Dor and was married to Taphath, Solomon's daughter.
